description: 引离白车——解法1：Rxe1引车离g1，后Qg2绝杀
explanation_en: Re1 forces White's rook away from g1 to capture. With the king's defender removed, Black's queen delivers mate on g2.

intro.popup: 💡 解法1：黑车引离g1的白车，黑后从d5杀入g2绝杀！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Variation 1: Black deflects the white rook from g1, allowing the queen to invade on g2 with checkmate.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Re1！白车被迫离开g1去吃车，g1空虚，黑后Qg2绝杀——引离就是让守卫者离开关键格。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Re1! forces the white rook away from g1 to capture. The square is left undefended, allowing Qg2#.

moves.popup: 黑车Re1！献车引离——白车必须应对，否则e1白车被吃。
moves.popup_en: Black plays Re1!, offering the rook to deflect White's rook. White must respond or lose the rook on e1.
White captures on e1 and is forced away from g1, leaving the square undefended.

moves.popup: 黑后Qg2# 绝杀！白王在h2，g2后覆盖所有逃格，绝杀！
moves.popup_en: Qg2# is checkmate! The queen controls every escape square around the white king on h2.
